screens.name: dashboard-signer
screens.notes: Aligned to the Paper 1000px dashboard shell: header actions, merged signer/runtime identity card, peer total/online/ready chips, offline placeholder row, permission method chips, populated Pending Approvals rows, compact domain-tagged Event Log, and bottom icon rail. The PWA visual harness uses deterministic runtime projection for Paper's latency, sparkline, pending approval, and event-log rows so the shared igloo-ui dashboard can be verified before those values are all available from live runtime state.

screens.name: dashboard-stopped
screens.notes: Stopped-signer visual state from the exported Paper dashboard: header actions remain Dashboard, Permissions, Settings; the merged runtime card shows Signer Stopped, key copy controls, and the offline relay summary; live Peers/Pending/Event sections are replaced with Readiness and Next Step cards.

screens.name: dashboard-all-relays-offline
screens.notes: All-relays-offline now uses the current Dashboard/Permissions/Settings header, merged runtime identity card, degraded signer status, Paper Readiness and Recovery state cards, and Retry Connections action. The PWA capture and exported Paper reference share the same 1440x533 state treatment.

screens.name: dashboard-signing-blocked
screens.notes: Signing-blocked now uses the current Dashboard/Permissions/Settings header, merged degraded runtime card, policy/readiness relay summary, Paper-style Common Causes and Operator Action cards, warning cause pills, and suppressed live Peers/Pending/Event sections. The PWA capture and exported Paper reference share the same 1440x569 state treatment.

screens.name: dashboard-signing-failed
screens.notes: Signing-failed captures the runtime failure modal over the dashboard shell with the Paper failure copy, detail block, Retry action, and Dismiss action.

screens.name: dashboard-permissions
screens.notes: Aligned to the decided peer-only PWA scope: the standalone browser signer renders Peer Permissions without the chrome-owned website/origin Signer Permissions section. The capture uses a DEV-only active-runtime projection so the four peer permission methods can be verified in their Paper colors, including dimmed inactive states.

screens.name: dashboard-settings
screens.notes: Settings now opens a right-side slide-over over the dashboard, with Device Profile, Group Profile, Onboard Device, Replace Share, Export Profile, Export Share, Browser Settings, Logout, and Clear Credentials housed in the shared igloo-ui sidebar. The Group Profile table includes Keyset Name, Keyset npub, Threshold, Created, and Updated from PWA profile metadata. Onboard a Device uses the shared explicit bfshare sponsorship flow for post-setup bfonboard package generation. PWA runtime-only numeric settings remain hidden from the Paper Settings sidebar.

screens.name: dashboard-settings-security
screens.notes: Scrolled-bottom capture for the shared Settings sidebar, covering the lower Export & Backup and Profile Security actions that are below the fold in the dashboard-height capture.

screens.name: dashboard-settings-onboard-device
screens.notes: The Settings Onboard Device action opens the shared igloo-ui configure dialog for creating a bfonboard handoff from an explicit protected bfshare source package.

screens.name: dashboard-clear-credentials
screens.notes: The Profile Security Clear Credentials action now uses a shared igloo-ui dialog with the Paper title, irreversible warning copy, red profile summary strip, Cancel, and Clear Credentials confirmation. The PWA confirm path stops the signer, deletes the selected saved profile, clears the unlock passphrase, and returns to the profile list.

screens.name: dashboard-settings-unsaved-changes
screens.notes: The Settings dirty-exit guard now uses a shared igloo-ui dialog matching Paper's clear-creds shell, with the canonical Settings copy plus Keep editing and Discard actions.

screens.name: dashboard-profile-password
screens.notes: The Settings Profile Password action now uses a shared igloo-ui dialog based on Paper's profile-password overlay treatment: lock icon, local profile encryption context, Current Password, New Password, Confirm New Password, Cancel, and Change Password. Paper has the unlock modal as the component source of truth, so the change-password copy is action-specific.

screens.name: dashboard-settings-mobile
screens.notes: Narrow-viewport guard for the shared Settings sidebar. The slide-over becomes full-width on phone-sized screens, keeps the Paper section order, and asserts that the panel and scroll body do not introduce horizontal overflow.

screens.name: dashboard-settings-onboard-handoff
screens.notes: DEV-only visual seam renders the in-memory Settings Onboard Device package handoff result. This covers the final bfonboard package, member/share summary, Copy, Save, QR code, and Done controls against the exported Paper handoff modal.

screens.name: dashboard-export-profile
screens.notes: The Export Profile password modal matches Paper: title, the 'Share #N (Index N) · Keyset · N relays · N peers' summary line, Export Password + Confirm Password with strength meter, and Cancel/Export. It now launches from the Settings slide-over backdrop.

screens.name: dashboard-replace-share-entry
screens.notes: Settings Replace Share launches the shared igloo-ui package-entry section with Paper terminology and bare flow shell treatment. After package validation the active PWA flow now moves directly into Paper's Applying Replacement state and starts replacing the local share; no extra post-validation confirmation step remains.

screens.name: dashboard-replace-share-applying
screens.notes: DEV-only visual seam renders the runtime-only Applying Replacement state without persisting the pending bfonboard connection. The shared igloo-ui panel shows the Paper timeline labels, package summary, and Cancel Replacement action while the replacement is in progress.

screens.name: dashboard-replace-share-failed
screens.notes: DEV-only visual seam renders the runtime-only Replacement Failed state with the Paper warning card, Retry, and Back to Replace Share actions.

screens.name: dashboard-replace-share-success
screens.notes: DEV-only visual seam renders the Share Replaced state with the Paper success card, replacement summary, unchanged group key/profile labels, old/new share key rows, and Return to Signer action.

screens.name: create-validation-error
screens.notes: Captured through the normal Create Keyset path by submitting an invalid optional private key, matching Paper's field-level validation state.

screens.name: import-save-profile
screens.notes: Captured through a DEV-only non-persisted visual seam so the passphrase-bearing pending import confirmation never enters localStorage.

screens.name: onboard-save-profile
screens.notes: Captured through a DEV-only non-persisted visual seam so the passphrase-bearing pending onboard connection never enters localStorage.

screens.name: rotate-collect-shares
screens.notes: Captured through the normal Welcome profile menu Rotate action with a saved 2-of-3 profile, covering the local device share passphrase row and first remote source row.
